svg.title: agentcore_gateway model backend · AgentCore Gateway in front of a private LiteLLM
svg.text: agentcore_gateway model backend · AgentCore Gateway in front of a private LiteLLM
No model key on the platform side or in any container · per-session SigV4 in, API key injected out · runtime → gateway over PrivateLink, gateway → LiteLLM over a managed VPC Lattice resource gateway

1–2 The shim signs each call with the session's STS credential (session policy: InvokeGateway on this gateway only; revoke = IAM Deny on the session tag). With private DNS on the interface endpoint, *.gateway.bedrock-agentcore.<region> resolves to endpoint ENIs: no NAT, no URL change.

3 No protocol translation: the gateway matches path (/v1/messages, /v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses only) and the body's model, replaces Authorization with the vault-held LiteLLM key, and relays the body and SSE stream verbatim.

4–5 provider.endpoint = https://<name on the public ACM cert> (TLS SNI + Host) · privateEndpoint.managedVpcResource.routingDomain = internal ALB DNS (where Lattice connects). The cert name needs no public DNS record.

Limit Lattice closes TCP connections idle for 350 s and the gateway returns no error, so a non-streaming call slower than that hangs: stream instead (Claude Code and the SDK kernel do). LiteLLM drop_params strips first-party-only fields.
